name: tpl-response-1-nogoal~p1
task: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a single 'at every moment' rule — whenever the ball is out of the way of the door (blocker_moved), the agent must be carrying the key then or pick it up later — which the hard Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key) expresses exactly ('then, or later' puts has_door_key on that step or after, so Response rather than RespondedExistence, and no 'next step' wording demands ChainResponse). blocker_moved is only the condition of the 'at every moment' sentence and has_door_key only its consequent, so neither is a commanded goal: no Existence is needed, the empty FINAL_STATES and the rule-only warning are valid, and the machine correctly shows the debt being owed whenever the ball is away without the key and closed once has_door_key holds.

texts: Whenever the ball is out of the way of the door, the agent must either be carrying the matching key at that moment or pick it up later.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key) -> u1
(u1, has_door_key) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, has_door_key, u0) -> 1
